prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for a detailed 16-bit side-scrolling run-and-gun mecha boss. Reference image is STYLE AND MATERIAL reference only: this white spacecraft transforms into this robot. Generate a NEW transparent PNG atlas, 1536x1024 landscape, exactly 3 columns x 2 rows of equal cells, generous transparent padding around EACH separate part, no overlap, no labels, no borders, no shadows, no floor, no full assembled robot. Six isolated mechanical components for animation, all facing LEFT in a shallow side/three-quarter view, matching pixel-art lighting from upper left. Top-left cell: large robot torso INCLUDING a small armored head, torso roughly square, cyan spacecraft cockpit becomes the inset chest, ivory chipped spacecraft armor, dark metal abdomen, two circular shoulder sockets and two lower hip sockets, no attached arms or legs. Top-middle cell: ONE thick upper arm, vertical orientation, rounded shoulder joint at top and elbow joint at bottom, ivory armor and exposed metal pistons. Top-right cell: ONE imposing forearm cannon, horizontal orientation with muzzle pointing LEFT, elbow connection at RIGHT, twin detailed dark gun barrels and ivory engine housing from the spaceship, small cyan coils, NOT firing. Bottom-left cell: ONE thigh, vertical, circular hip socket at top, knee socket at bottom, thick ivory armor with dark hydraulic joints. Bottom-middle cell: ONE lower leg AND attached heavy boot, shin vertical and boot toe extends LEFT along bottom, knee socket centered at top, ivory armor, visible pistons and dark heavy tread. Bottom-right cell: ONE swept spacecraft wing and engine backpack fin, tall tapered ivory wing panel, cyan exhaust nozzle at lower end, matches spacecraft reference. Each component is complete and fills its own cell without touching borders. Rich crisp SNK-era pixel-art material detail, strong dark outlines, disciplined warm ivory/slate/cyan palette, visible pixel clusters, mechanical bolts, vents, chipped paint, deeply shaded joints. No gradients or photorealism, no smooth vector geometry, no text, no weapons effects. Actual transparent background. Components must be suitable to assemble into one coherent articulated robot, not six different robots.
